0.prompt:
Product turnaround reference sheet for 3D modelling, pure white seamless background, flat even studio light, no shadows on the ground, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines. Exactly 4 columns and 3 rows of equal cells. Each COLUMN is one object; each ROW is one view: row 1 = straight front view, row 2 = exact left side profile (90 degrees), row 3 = straight back view. Orthographic-looking camera at mid height, the whole object fully inside its cell with margin, same scale for the same object in all three rows, nothing crosses a cell edge. Late-Soviet 1970s Baltic seaside town style, realistic materials.
Column 1: bronze statue of a slim girl in a light summer dress standing on tiptoe and releasing a dove from her raised hands, warm patinated bronze, on a square polished red granite plinth (plinth about one third of the total height).
Column 2: bronze monument of a Baltic fisherman in oilskin coat and sou'wester hauling a heavy net over his shoulder, dark green-brown patina, on a rough grey granite block plinth.
Column 3: large Soviet palace-of-culture ceiling chandelier, polished brass central stem with three stacked rings, many frosted white glass globe shades, short brass suspension rod with a ceiling cup at the top, seen hanging.
Column 4: cast-iron public drinking fountain on a fluted column, dark green paint, small round bowl with a brass spout on top, a lower dog bowl at the side, square base.
0.note: girl_dove column superseded by sheet 4 (hi3d dropped the dove and plinth from these views)
